annotations.text:
Full hi-fi single-page design.

White sections = black content. Inverted sections (Stack, Projects, Design Skills, Footer) = black bg, white content.

Floating rounded pill nav, hero with your B/W portrait (grey placeholder for now), then section by section: About, Tech Stack, Experience + Education, Projects (6), Certifications, Design Skills, Contact.

Saira typeface throughout. Motion: fade-up on load, skill ticker, spinning mark, hover-lift cards. Once approved this gets built as a real Next.js site.
